method: Direct raw CSV aggregation. No processed player-stat table is used for ranking inputs.
scope: India-hosted T20 and T20I; innings 1 and 2; death overs overid 16-20 only. Ranking uses each bowler's latest 10 eligible Indian death-over innings and requires the latest Indian death-over appearance to be in 2026.

definitions.legal_ball: extras_type none, byes, or legbyes; wides and Overstep/no-balls are not legal; other, Penalty, blank and unrecognized types are excluded.
definitions.bowler_runs: Raw runs plus one per wide or Overstep/no-ball delivery; byes and leg-byes are not charged to the bowler.
definitions.dot_ball: A legal death-over ball with zero team runs; byes and leg-byes imputed as one team run per delivery.
definitions.credited_wicket: is_wicket with dismissal_type Caught, Bowled, LBW, Stump, or Hit Wicket.
definitions.boundary_concession: Raw is_four plus is_six events per 100 legal death-over balls.
definitions.singles_twos_containment: Rate of legal death-over balls yielding exactly one or two team runs; lower is better. Byes and leg-byes add one team run for this metric.
definitions.economy: Death-over bowler runs times six divided by death-over legal balls. The ranking uses the latest 10 eligible Indian death-over innings; career Indian death-over figures are shown separately.
definitions.wickets_per_100: Credited death-over wickets times 100 divided by death-over legal balls.
definitions.percentile_scoring: Each latest-10 component is converted to a tie-aware 0-100 percentile across eligible players. Lower economy, boundary rate and singles/twos rate receive higher percentiles.
definitions.composite_formula: 30% adjusted economy percentile + 25% dot-ball percentage percentile + 20% adjusted wickets/100 percentile + 15% inverse boundary-concession-rate percentile + 10% inverse singles/twos-rate percentile. Components use the latest 10 Indian death-over innings only.
definitions.shrinkage: For the composite only, latest-10 economy and wickets/100 are blended toward the eligible-player latest-10 death-over baseline using 60 prior legal balls. Career Indian death-over rates are displayed separately.
definitions.eligibility: At least 30 legal death-over balls and at least 3 credited wickets within the latest 10 India death-over cohort innings, at least one 2026 T20/T20I bowling appearance at any venue, 10 eligible India death-over innings, and a latest Indian death-over appearance in 2026. Jamie Overton (2382), Lungi Ngidi (4641), and Gerald Coetzee (6628) are excluded from the final ranking at the user's request. Unknown or multi-name player IDs are excluded. If an unknown-legality delivery occurs in an innings, that delivery and all later deliveries in that innings are excluded.
definitions.outcomes: Match wins, losses, and win contribution are not used.

ranking_status: Ranked 51 eligible bowlers using the requested weighted death-over score.
